mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies near the Verona Public Library under a waxing crescent moon. The International Space Station passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. The temperature is 65 degrees, with an overnight low of 58 degrees and rain predicted.

The Verona Police Department released their weekly recap of service calls. Notable incidents include multiple vehicle crashes and one arrest on an outstanding warrant in the 100 block of Prairie Oaks Drive.

There is plenty to do in Verona this week. Today features Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the downtown farmer's market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and several trivia options at local venues.

During the week of October 5 to October 12, officers handled a variety of incidents, including a motor vehicle crash on October 7 involving a juvenile on an e-moto that resulted in minor injuries and a citation for the parent.
Today's flavor is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM tonight.
